reason: The 14-day side-by-side test with no auto-billing is exactly the proof I'd want, and the 'minutes after I put the phone down' idea fits my bedtime that shifts every week. If my own numbers show I fall asleep faster, I'd pay the 4,900 monthly once to see if it holds, not the yearly plan yet.
objection: Can a phone lying on the bed really tell when I fell asleep? If the sleep-detection is off, the comparison is just marketing with a chart on it, and the free version already plays without ads.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison shows little or no difference, or the app-store reviews say the sleep timing is inaccurate, I stay on the free version.
